Privacy.meta_description: How Dictus processes your voice locally and protects your data. Privacy policy for the app and website.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: On iOS, your voice and transcribed text stay on your device. On Desktop, audio transcription is also local. Optional post-processing, disabled by default, may send transcribed text to a provider you explicitly choose.
Privacy.scope: This policy covers the Dictus apps for iOS and Desktop, and the getdictus.com website.
Privacy.data_collection_text: The Dictus apps do not require a Dictus account and include no telemetry or analytics tools. The website uses no advertising cookies or analytics tools. If you choose to donate, the payment provider processes the data needed for that transaction.
Privacy.full_access_text: On iOS, Full Access permission is needed for the dictation keyboard to work. Your voice and transcribed text are processed on your device.
Privacy.data_usage_text: Your voice is used to produce a transcription on your device. On Desktop, post-processing is disabled by default. If you enable it and choose a remote provider, the transcribed text and associated instructions are sent to that provider for the processing you request.
Privacy.third_party_text: Downloading models and checking for updates require network connections. On Desktop, a remote post-processing provider is used only after your explicit choice. Apple processes iOS in-app purchases through the App Store. When you donate, Stripe or BTCPay processes payment data. These services apply their own terms and policies, and Dictus does not receive your card credentials.
Privacy.data_retention_text: Preferences and model files are stored locally on your device. Data sent to a post-processing provider you have chosen, to Apple for an iOS purchase, or to a payment provider for a donation is subject to that service’s retention policies.
Privacy.user_rights_text: You retain control of the data stored locally on your device. For data processed by a post-processing or payment provider, consult its policy and contact that service. For questions about Dictus, contact us at the address below.
Privacy.children_text: The same principles of local processing and no telemetry apply to all users of the Dictus apps, including children.
Privacy.security_text: Speech recognition runs on your device. On Desktop, model downloads and update checks do not send audio or transcribed text. Sending text for remote post-processing requires you to enable it and choose a provider. The Desktop documentation details possible connections and their settings.
Privacy.changes_text: Updates will be posted on this page with a revised date.

Pricing.meta_title: Pricing — Free Desktop and Dictus Pro for iPhone
Pricing.title: Dictation, your way.
Pricing.description: Free on desktop and iPhone, with optional Dictus Pro.

desktop.title: Dictus Desktop
desktop.description: Dictate on macOS, Windows and Linux. Transcription runs locally, the code is public and no subscription is needed.

Pricing.ios_title: On iPhone, at your own pace.
Pricing.ios_intro: A permanent free foundation. One Dictus Pro, with three ways to pay when it launches.

free.title: Free
free.description: The keyboard and local dictation, without a Pro purchase. Available on iOS 17 and later in apps that support third-party keyboards.

pro.availability: Pro purchases will be made in the iOS app through Apple when they launch.

Pricing.territory: France/EUR reference. Apple shows the price for your country before you buy.
Pricing.smart_compatibility: Smart Modes and AI correction require iOS 26 or later, enabled Apple Intelligence and a compatible iPhone: iPhone 15 Pro or 15 Pro Max, iPhone 16 models or later, or iPhone Air. A supported language and region are required. Buying Pro does not change your device’s compatibility.
Pricing.lifetime_scope: The lifetime purchase covers every current and future Pro feature that runs on your device or on a server you provide. Any feature relying on Dictus infrastructure is a separate offering.

dictation.title: Keyboard and local dictation
dictation.summary: Your voice becomes text on your iPhone, in apps that accept third-party keyboards.
dictation.detail: Audio transcription runs on your device. Some apps and protected fields do not accept third-party keyboards.

normal.title: Punctuation and Normal mode
normal.summary: Correction that stays faithful to your text. AI correction depends on iOS 26 and Apple Intelligence.
normal.detail: Punctuation depends on the model. Normal mode correction stays free on devices with Apple Intelligence enabled on iOS 26, in a supported language and region.

models.title: Model selection
models.summary: Download and manage the Whisper or Parakeet models offered for your device.
models.detail: Models download once, then transcribe locally. Availability and performance depend on the device, memory, app version and supported languages.

activity.title: Dictation status
activity.summary: Live Activity and Dynamic Island, depending on your iPhone’s capabilities.
activity.detail: Live Activities depend on your iOS version and settings. Dynamic Island display requires an iPhone equipped with Dynamic Island.

smart.title: Smart Modes
smart.summary: Translate, Message, List, Structured and Summary, with Apple Intelligence and iOS 26 on a compatible iPhone.
smart.detail: Translate into a supported language, Message, List, Structured and Summary. Requires iOS 26 and enabled Apple Intelligence: iPhone 15 Pro / Pro Max, iPhone 16 models or later, or iPhone Air; supported language and region.

vocabulary.title: Custom vocabulary
vocabulary.summary: Define misheard variants and the term that should replace them. No Apple Intelligence needed.
vocabulary.detail: Replaces transcription variants you define with your preferred term. Each term needs at least one variant to take effect. This does not train the speech model or require Apple Intelligence.

history.title: Local history
history.summary: Search, read, copy or delete your last {historyLimit} dictations. No Apple Intelligence needed.
history.detail: Keeps the last {historyLimit} dictations locally, with search, viewing, copying and deletion. History does not require Apple Intelligence.

voiceNotes.title: Voice notes
voiceNotes.summary: Transcribe the voice messages you receive by sharing them to Dictus. The transcript needs no Apple Intelligence.
voiceNotes.detail: Share a voice message or audio file from your chat app to Dictus to transcribe it on your iPhone, up to 10 minutes. The transcript works without Apple Intelligence; the summary of a voice note requires it.

comparison.title: The details, simply.
comparison.description: The same Pro features, however you pay.
comparison.caption: Comparison of free iPhone features and Dictus Pro

free.question: What stays free?
free.answer: Desktop will stay free. On iPhone, the keyboard, local dictation, Normal mode, models and dictation status stay free. Some apps do not support third-party keyboards; available features depend on your device.

platforms.question: Does Pro also cover my computer?
platforms.answer: Pro is for iOS only. Desktop stays free. Android is a free public beta; this offering includes neither an Android licence nor cross-device sync.

plans.question: How do the three options differ?
plans.answer: {proLaunch, select, available {} other {Pro purchases are not available yet; they open with Dictus 2.0. }}The three options unlock the same features: {monthly}/month, {yearly}/year or {lifetime} paid once. Subscriptions renew automatically. Purchases are made in the iOS app through Apple, which confirms the price for your country. Vocabulary replaces variants you define without training the speech model. History keeps your last {historyLimit} dictations to search, read, copy or delete.

trial.question: How does the trial work?
trial.answer: On an iPhone compatible with Smart Modes, Dictus Pro is free for {trialDays} days, once per device. No payment and no subscription are needed. When the trial ends, Pro switches off unless you choose a plan or the one-time purchase. Nothing is charged automatically.

compatibility.question: Is my iPhone compatible?
compatibility.answer: The free app requires iOS 17 or later. AI modes and intelligent correction require iOS 26 or later and enabled Apple Intelligence: iPhone 15 Pro or 15 Pro Max, iPhone 16 models or later, or iPhone Air, in a supported language and region. The free Pro trial is offered on these iPhones. Buying Pro does not change these requirements. History, vocabulary and voice note transcripts do not require Apple Intelligence. Models depend on device, memory, app version and languages; Dynamic Island requires an iPhone equipped with it.

manage.question: How do I manage or cancel a subscription?
manage.answer: Open Settings, your name, then Subscriptions. Turn off renewal at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Access continues until the paid period ends. The one-time purchase does not renew.

restore.question: Will I be able to restore my purchase?
restore.answer: Yes, with the same Apple account used to pay. Use Restore Purchases in Dictus on your compatible iOS devices. Support can help if needed.

privacy.question: Does transcription stay local?
privacy.answer: Yes, audio is transcribed on your device. Model downloads, updates and payments use the network. On Desktop, optional post-processing, disabled by default, may send text to a provider you choose.

donation.question: Does a donation unlock Dictus Pro?
donation.answer: No. Donations support the free project; they do not unlock Pro or change your subscription.

support.title: Support the free project.
support.description: A donation supports the free project without unlocking Pro.
